digest: Alerts triggered by a scheduled detection validation exercise in an isolated lab environment. No actual malicious activity occurred, and no production systems were impacted.

evidence_findings.title: Scheduled Exercise Confirmation
evidence_findings.subject: Case
evidence_findings.evidence: The case comment states: 'This is the scheduled quarterly detection-validation exercise CHG-4821 in the isolated BUILD-LAB network. The SOC lead approved the exact simulation from 13:00 through 14:00 UTC.' An artifact note confirms 'Execution was initiated by service account svc_detection_test under approved change CHG-4821.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: The reported critical alerts are part of an approved, controlled simulation and not a real incident.

evidence_findings.title: No Malicious Outcome on Endpoint
evidence_findings.subject: BUILD-LAB-03
evidence_findings.evidence: An EDR note for the process execution on BUILD-LAB-03 states: 'EDR recorded simulation markers only: no file encryption, credential access, persistence, or payload download occurred. Binary hash matches the internally signed validation tool inventory.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: The simulated attack on BUILD-LAB-03 did not result in actual compromise, data loss, or unauthorized activity.

evidence_findings.title: Network Isolation Confirmed
evidence_findings.subject: Network Traffic
evidence_findings.evidence: An artifact note states: 'CMDB identifies both hosts as isolated cyber-range assets with no route to production.' A network verification note confirms: 'Destination is the internal exercise controller. Firewall confirms the isolated range blocked all external egress during the exercise.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: The lab environment is isolated, preventing any simulated malicious network activity from impacting production systems.

attack_chain.description: Simulated execution initiated by service account svc_detection_test as part of an approved exercise.
The 'attack-simulator.exe' tool was executed on BUILD-LAB-03.
Simulated C2 beacon traffic was observed from 10.250.0.23 to the internal exercise controller 10.250.0.10 on port 8443.

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: Case created, indicating the start of the simulated activity.
Analyst confirms the activity is a scheduled detection validation exercise.

ioc_indicators.context: Destination IP for simulated C2 traffic, identified as SIM-CONTROLLER-01.
Source IP for simulated C2 beacon traffic, likely BUILD-LAB-03.
Exercise controller and destination for simulated C2 traffic.
Host where the attack simulation tool was executed.
Service account used to initiate the simulation.

remediations.description: Review and refine alert suppression or tagging mechanisms for known, approved detection validation exercises to prevent future false positive incidents.
Ensure all relevant security and operations teams are aware of scheduled exercises and their expected alert patterns to minimize investigation overhead.
